subject.title: fix(google-vertex): add Google Vertex AI onboarding wizard, fix ADC auth, add provider docs

question: After the static catalog bug is fixed, should OpenClaw accept PR #87800's Google Vertex ADC setup contract: permissive auth evidence, request-time invalid-ADC failure, setup-written project/location/default model/marker, and core fallback transport default?
rationale: The patch changes provider auth/setup semantics and onboarding defaults beyond a local bug fix, so automation should not choose the permanent product contract alone.

options.title: Fix catalog, then accept setup contract
options.body: Require the manifest catalog to be complete or refreshable, then land the PR as the intended Google Vertex ADC onboarding path with maintainer-owned release notes/proof expectations.

options.title: Narrow auth/default behavior
options.body: Keep stricter setup-time evidence or reduce setup-written defaults while preserving the proven onboarding flow.

options.title: Pause behind the Vertex cluster
options.body: Use this PR as proof but wait for #60736 and related Vertex PRs to settle the provider boundary first.

recommendation.title: Fix catalog, then accept setup contract
recommendation.body: Require the manifest catalog to be complete or refreshable, then land the PR as the intended Google Vertex ADC onboarding path with maintainer-owned release notes/proof expectations.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice crosses provider onboarding, manifest catalog authority, setup defaults, and maintainer product policy touched by recent provider catalog onboarding work.
